page.overview:
Who is Shallot?

Shallot is a Saiyan who has a medium build, and hair resembling a much shorter version of Raditz's with a front fringe straying to the right. He wears blue colored leather Sadala Saiyan armor, being from the time before Frieza Force armor became standard. His armor plates, greaves, and armbands are blue, and the undershirt and shorts are black. He has silver-tipped blue boots, and a black tail which he lets swing freely, rather than securing it around his waist as most modern adult Saiyans do.

Shallot has good fighting potential and is quite short tempered and aggressive like usual Saiyans. Although quick to go off at people, Shallot has his own morals and does not like being commanded. Like Goku and Vegeta, he has a strong appetite and similar to Beerus and Whis, he develops a fondness for Earth cuisine to the point he believes Dodoria has bad sense of taste after he claims Earth's food is terrible. He is noted to have a similar personality to Caulifla and the two get along. Shallot also seems to judge a warrior not by power but by how determined they are. Like most Saiyans, Shallot has little interest in romance and like the pure-hearted Goku, lacks perverted thoughts (as Master Roshi suggests Shallot is pure of heart) though unlike Goku seemingly fails to recognize this trait in others as he couldn't understand why Caulifla and Rozie were enraged by Master Roshi's lecherous behavior. It is unclear if this is due to his personality and/or another result of his lack of memory.

However, he is shown to be able to tell males and females apart just fine and rejects the teenage Bulma's playful attempt to flirt with him when she cheekily suggests that he secretly longs for her company after they had been apart for a while. Additionally, when she compliments him after he saves her and Jaco from some Saibamen shortly after they first met, Shallot was quick to point out that complimenting him won't get her anymore free security and only agreed to become her bodyguard after she convinced him that she could teach him more about Earth. Additionally, Shallot makes it clear that he plans to "bleed" them dry of their knowledge and dismisses Jaco's criticism that he shouldn't have said his intentions out loud. Shallot also has a tendency to use words relating to violence, regardless as to whether he is speaking metaphorically, such as the aforementioned "bleed them dry" phrase or literally when he threatened that his second confrontation with Raditz would be a "massacre".

However, despite his initial coldness, he can't stand to see innocents such as children harmed and rejected Raditz's offer to join him in taking down Piccolo and Gohan, as Shallot had no intention of beating up a little kid. However, he can be somewhat tactless and ends upsetting Gohan with an offhand remark. However, he learns from his mistakes and later even tells Piccolo after he recovers to be nice to Gohan.
